---
title: "Crossref caption prefix, all float forms"
# bd-n3sark9b: every float form must render its caption with the numbered
# "Kind N: " prefix. The attribute-form figure and the caption-form table
# used to lose it — their captions reach the crossref renderer as `Plain`
# (Pandoc's own Figure/Table caption convention) and the prefix step only
# handled `Paragraph`. References resolved fine the whole time, which is
# why this went unnoticed: "See Figure 2" worked while the figcaption read
# just "Attr form caption". Q1 prefixes all three.
#
# Phase 2 of the same strand canonicalizes the caption block to Plain for
# every form, so the figcaption never contains a <p> (Q1 emits bare inlines
# for all three forms).
#
# Drives the real reader → pipeline → HTML writer path; the unit-level
# coverage lives in crates/quarto-core/src/transforms/crossref_render.rs
# and the reader-level coverage in
# crates/quarto-core/tests/integration/crossref_fixtures.rs.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            "Figure 1: Div form caption",
            "Figure 2: Attr form caption",
            "Table 1: Table caption form",
          ]
        # Every figcaption holds bare inlines (Q1 parity): the div-form
        # trailing paragraph is canonicalized to Plain at the sugar boundary,
        # so no form wraps its caption in <p>.
        - ["<figcaption[^>]*>\\s*<p>"]
---
